prompt: On Reports, if I click "Last 90 days" and then quickly "Last 7 days", the 7-day button stays selected but the chart shows 90 days of data.

truth.summary: The hand-written loadReports thunk dispatches REPORTS_RECEIVED for whichever response arrives, without checking that it still matches the requested range, so the slower 90-day response overwrites the 7-day one.

referenceAnswer.cause: The thunk does not ignore stale responses, so the slow 90d request resolves after the 7d request and overwrites its data.

decoyAnswers.cause: The range buttons are not disabled while loading.
REPORTS_REQUESTED does not reset the old data.

referenceFix.find: dispatch({ type: REPORTS_RECEIVED, throughput, cycleTime, workload })
referenceFix.replace:
const current = getState().reports
      if (current.projectKey !== projectKey || current.range !== range) return
      dispatch({ type: REPORTS_RECEIVED, throughput, cycleTime, workload })

genieEvidence.notes: Genie has no Redux or thunk awareness. The timeline shows the two throughput requests completing out of order (paths only; the range query parameter is stripped, so the two are indistinguishable). app_redux_state shows reports.range '7d' with reports.throughput.range '90d', and app_redux_actions shows RECEIVED arriving after the second REQUESTED.
